notes.notes:
Seduction has 2 new updates - Visual update and Difficulty update

1. Visual update

A visual change to make the game more appealing without losing the nostalgia feeling.

notes.title: Seduction is going to release at Oct.9 2021
notes.notes:
Seduction is going to release at October 9, 2021, 14:00 (UTC+8). If you missed the Tokyo Game Show, please check the video below:

[previewyoutube=ljzVUuN_p2A;leftthumb][/previewyoutube]

Seduction is a 2d horror adventure puzzle game. Lee has to survive in the dark realm and to reveal the truth of the temple buried in the temple.

Seduction is a project that I have a lot fun making due to the unique playable character and setting.  Playing as a Chinese monk is something we usually don't see a lot in video games as well as exploring concepts that is intriguing and different. I hope players can simply enjoy the game and the journey. 

Thank you!

Add seduction to wishlist and get informed for the latest news!
